title: Proposal Initiator
description: Which party originated a proposal. Experimental in AdCP 3.3 (media_buy.seller_offers). Absent means buyer. A seller proposal is an offer: a committed amendment or negotiated cancellation of an accepted media buy.

enumDescriptions.buyer: Originated by the buyer, including a buyer's revision of a seller offer. The implied value when absent.
enumDescriptions.seller: An offer against an accepted media buy: always committed, carries an offer_reason on its list_proposals row, and takes effect only when the buyer calls accept_proposal.
